purpose: Independent worker-side questions; previous frozen and INV154 caller questions remain unchanged.

questions.query: Why do the Rayon workers finish late during the long Windows Rapier space_step intervals?
facts: The actual job-completing worker is ready but largely unscheduled while same-process WARP-associated rendering threads occupy most logical CPU residency at mostly higher observed priorities.
The result is specific to the retained Windows software-ANGLE cohort and does not establish a universal hardware-GPU result or a specific shader cost.

questions.query: Does Rayon in_worker_cold mean Rapier starts threads every step, and do two caller wakes mean two physics jobs?
facts: The pool is persistent; in_worker_cold injects work from an external caller and is not evidence of per-step startup.
Two wakes may be condition-variable notification and mutex reacquisition in one completion latch; completion attribution needs exact job and wake stacks, not idle-helper averages.
